findings.title: Signal has significant reference plane gap
findings.description: Net /MOSI_SRC has 50% reference plane coverage over 2.2mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has significant reference plane gap

findings.title: Signal has significant reference plane gap
findings.description: Net /SCK_SRC has 75% reference plane coverage over 2.5mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.
findings.summary: Signal has significant reference plane gap

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J3
findings.description: Connector J3 (GDEY075T7 / BOTTOM CONTACT) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J3. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J3

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (XIAO LEFT / USB UP) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add ESD protection (e.g., USBLC6-2SC6 or TPD2E2U06) on J1 data lines. Add ferrite bead (600Ω@100MHz) on VBUS. For USB 3.x, add common-mode choke on SuperSpeed pairs.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J1

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J2
findings.description: Connector J2 (XIAO RIGHT / USB UP) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add ESD protection (e.g., USBLC6-2SC6 or TPD2E2U06) on J2 data lines. Add ferrite bead (600Ω@100MHz) on VBUS. For USB 3.x, add common-mode choke on SuperSpeed pairs.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J2

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J3
findings.description: J3 (GDEY075T7 / BOTTOM CONTACT) has 3 ground pin(s) for 17 signal pins. Recommended: at least 5 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J3 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J3

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J1
findings.description: J1 (XIAO LEFT / USB UP) has 0 ground pin(s) for 4 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J1 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J1

findings.title: Insufficient ground pins on J2
findings.description: J2 (XIAO RIGHT / USB UP) has 1 ground pin(s) for 3 signal pins. Recommended: at least 2 ground pins for adequate return current path and cable shielding.
findings.recommendation: Ensure J2 has sufficient ground pins. For high-speed interfaces, ground pins should be distributed among signal pins, not grouped at one end.
findings.summary: Insufficient ground pins on J2

findings.title: Clock /EPD_SCK routed near connector J2
findings.description: Clock net /EPD_SCK passes within 7.8mm of connector J2. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /EPD_SCK away from J2, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /EPD_SCK routed near connector J2

findings.title: Clock /EPD_SCK routed near connector J3
findings.description: Clock net /EPD_SCK passes within 2.3mm of connector J3. Clock harmonics can couple to attached cables via proximity, increasing radiated emissions.
findings.recommendation: Route /EPD_SCK away from J3, or add ground guard traces between the clock and connector.
findings.summary: Clock /EPD_SCK routed near connector J3

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (60×50mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1191 MHz; (0,1) at 1429 MHz; (1,1) at 1860 MHz; (2,0) at 2382 MHz; (2,1) at 2778 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /PREVGH
findings.description: Net /PREVGH has 4 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu. 4 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /PREVGH
